    {b sieveExponent : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 < b) (hb1 : b < 1) (hsieve : sieveExponent < 1)
    (kappaMax : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hAtPrecision : ∀ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta → delta ≤ 1 →
      ∃ (Q : ℕ → Finset ℕ) (rho : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ),

            (∀ n : ℕ,
              (if Nat.Coprime n
                  (sieveProduct N (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ sieveExponent)))
                then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
                physicalDivisorSum (Q N) (rho N) n) ∧
            finiteSourceMass (S N) (weight N) ≤
              (Real.log (1 / b) + delta) * ((N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ)) ∧
            physicalDensitySum (Q N) (rho N) ≤
              (currentK + delta) * (singularSeries N / Real.log (N : ℝ)) ∧
            |∑ d ∈ Q N, rho N d *
                ((finiteCoprimeMass (S N) (weight N) d -
                    finiteSourceMass (S N) (weight N)) / (Nat.totient d : ℝ))| ≤
              delta * singularNormalization N ∧
            |∑ d ∈ Q N, rho N d *
                finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy (S N) (weight N) N d| ≤
              delta * singularNormalization N) :

      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Even N →
        (RealB b N : ℝ) ≤

  let J : ℝ := Real.log (1 / b)
  have hJ : 0 < J := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    exact (one_lt_div hb).mpr hb1
  have hK : 0 < currentK := by norm_num [currentK]
  let budgetDenominator : ℝ := currentK + J + 5
  have hdenominator : 0 < budgetDenominator := by
    dsimp [budgetDenominator]
    linarith
  let delta : ℝ := min 1 (epsilon / budgetDenominator)
  have hdelta : 0 < delta := lt_min zero_lt_one (div_pos hepsilon hdenominator)
  have hdeltaOne : delta ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hdeltaBudget : delta * budgetDenominator ≤ epsilon :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hdenominator).mp (min_le_right _ _)
  have hcoefficient : (J + delta) * (currentK + delta) + 4 * delta ≤

    have hsquare : delta * delta ≤ delta := by
      simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdeltaOne hdelta.le
    dsimp only [budgetDenominator] at hdeltaBudget
    nlinarith only [hsquare, hdeltaBudget]
  obtain ⟨Q, rho, _kappa, _hkappa, _hmediumCap,
    kappaTrim, hkappaTrim, _htrimGap, S, weight, hprecision⟩ :=
    hAtPrecision delta hdelta hdeltaOne

      (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ sieveExponent) : ℝ) ≤ delta * singularNormalization N := by
    simpa only [one_mul, pow_zero, mul_one] using
      eventually_ceil_powerLog_le_singularNormalization 1 sieveExponent 0

  have hcutoff : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappaTrim N + 1 ≤ delta * singularNormalization N := by
    simpa only [manuscriptHalfProductCutoff, pow_zero, mul_one] using
      eventually_powerLog_add_one_le_singularNormalization 2 (1 - kappaTrim) 0

  filter_upwards [hprecision, hcap, hcutoff, eventually_ge_atTop (2 : ℕ)]
    with N hprecisionN hcapN hcutoffN hN
  intro hEven
  rcases hprecisionN hEven with
    ⟨hSN, hsourceN, houterN, hmajorN, hmassN, hdensityN, hcoprimeN, hdistributionN⟩
  have hN1 : (1 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < N by omega)
  have hmassScale : 0 < (N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ) :=
    div_pos (lt_trans zero_lt_one hN1) (Real.log_pos hN1)
  have hdensityScale := densityScale_pos hN
  have hnormalization : 0 ≤ singularNormalization N := by
    rw [← sourceMassScale_mul_densityScale N]
    exact (mul_pos hmassScale hdensityScale).le

    finiteSourceMass_nonneg_of_indicator_outer
      (realHalfProductSource b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappaTrim N))
      (S N) (weight N) houterN
  have hmain :
      finiteSourceMass (S N) (weight N) * physicalDensitySum (Q N) (rho N) ≤
        ((J + delta) * (currentK + delta)) * singularNormalization N := by
    calc
      finiteSourceMass (S N) (weight N) * physicalDensitySum (Q N) (rho N) ≤
          finiteSourceMass (S N) (weight N) *
            ((currentK + delta) * (singularSeries N / Real.log (N : ℝ))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdensityN hmassNonneg
      _ ≤ ((J + delta) * ((N : ℝ) / Real.log (N : ℝ))) *
          ((currentK + delta) * (singularSeries N / Real.log (N : ℝ))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmassN
          (mul_nonneg (add_nonneg hK.le hdelta.le) hdensityScale.le)
      _ = ((J + delta) * (currentK + delta)) * singularNormalization N := by
        rw [← sourceMassScale_mul_densityScale N]
        ring
  have hcoprimeUpper := (le_abs_self
    (∑ d ∈ Q N, rho N d *
      ((finiteCoprimeMass (S N) (weight N) d - finiteSourceMass (S N) (weight N)) /
        (Nat.totient d : ℝ)))).trans hcoprimeN
  have hdistributionUpper := (le_abs_self
    (∑ d ∈ Q N, rho N d *
      finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy (S N) (weight N) N d)).trans hdistributionN
  have hfinite := RealB_cast_le_same_rho_outer_main_add_errors N
    (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ sieveExponent)) (S N) (Q N) (weight N) (rho N) hb1
    (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff_nonneg kappaTrim N)
    hSN hsourceN houterN hmajorN
  calc
    (RealB b N : ℝ) ≤
        ((J + delta) * (currentK + delta)) * singularNormalization N +
          delta * singularNormalization N + delta * singularNormalization N +
          delta * singularNormalization N + delta * singularNormalization N :=
      hfinite.trans (add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add hmain
        hcoprimeUpper) hdistributionUpper) hcapN) hcutoffN)
    _ = ((J + delta) * (currentK + delta) + 4 * delta) * singularNormalization N := by ring
    _ ≤ (currentK * J + epsilon) * singularNormalization N :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoefficient hnormalization

This gives delta>0,delta<=1,delta*(K+J+5)<=epsilon and delta^2<=delta, so the exact main coefficient plus four delta costs fits K*J+epsilon. Obtain one Q/rho/medium-kappa/trim/S/weight tuple only at this precision; intersect its one eventual event with both endpoint budgets and N>=2. LetT reduces to the exact selected cutoff. Derive mass>=0 with the helper. Bound mass*density by first using nonnegative mass and then nonnegative density upper scale. Replace the two literal signed whole-modulus sums by their absolute bounds. Apply the actual finite outer bridge with original hSN, exact T,z and same Q/rho/S/weight. Add the two error and two endpoint costs; multiply the coefficient budget by the proved nonnegative unchanged singularNormalization. The final target is the actual hUpper formula, but all hAtPrecision suppliers remain hypotheses.

theorem RealB_cast_le_same_rho_outer_main_add_errors
    {b T : ℝ} (N z : ℕ) (S Q : Finset ℕ) (weight rho : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hb : b < 1) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hSN : ∀ m ∈ S, m ≤ N)
    (hsource : realHalfProductSource b N T ⊆ S)
    (houter : ∀ m ∈ S,
      (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ weight m)
    (hmajor : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (if Nat.Coprime n (sieveProduct N z) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        physicalDivisorSum Q rho n) :
    (RealB b N : ℝ) ≤
      finiteSourceMass S weight * physicalDensitySum Q rho +
        (∑ d ∈ Q, rho d *
          ((finiteCoprimeMass S weight d - finiteSourceMass S weight) /
            (Nat.totient d : ℝ))) +
        (∑ d ∈ Q, rho d * finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy S weight N d) +
        (z : ℝ) + (T + 1) := by
  classical
  have hnonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ physicalDivisorSum Q rho n := by
    intro n
    have h := hmajor n
    split_ifs at h with hcop
    · exact zero_le_one.trans h
    · exact h
  have hsum :
      (∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
        physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m)) ≤
      ∑ m ∈ S, weight m * physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m) := by
    calc
      (∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
          physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m)) =
          ∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
            (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
              physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro m hm
        simp only [hm, if_pos, one_mul]
      _ = ∑ m ∈ S,
          (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
            physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m) := by
        apply Finset.sum_subset hsource
        intro m hmS hmSource
        simp only [if_neg hmSource, zero_mul]
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun m hm =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (houter m hm) (hnonneg (N - m))
  have h := (RealB_cast_le_sum_physicalDivisorSum_add_cap_cutoff
    N z Q rho hb hT hmajor).trans
      (add_le_add (add_le_add hsum (le_refl (z : ℝ))) (le_refl (T + 1)))

/-- The total weight on the common finite carrier. -/
def finiteSourceMass (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ m ∈ S, w m

/-- The literal weighted sum in the residue class `a` modulo `d`. -/
def finiteCongruenceMass (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ m ∈ S with Nat.ModEq d m a, w m

/-- The literal weighted sum restricted to integers coprime to `d`. -/
def finiteCoprimeMass (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ m ∈ S with Nat.Coprime m d, w m

/-- The actual coprime-normalized discrepancy. Its definition also makes
sense for nonprimitive classes and for Lean's totalized division at zero. -/
def finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy
    (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  finiteCongruenceMass S w a d - finiteCoprimeMass S w d / (Nat.totient d : ℝ)

theorem RealB_cast_le_same_rho_outer_main_add_errors
    {b T : ℝ} (N z : ℕ) (S Q : Finset ℕ) (weight rho : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hb : b < 1) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (hSN : ∀ m ∈ S, m ≤ N)
    (hsource : realHalfProductSource b N T ⊆ S)
    (houter : ∀ m ∈ S,
      (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ weight m)
    (hmajor : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (if Nat.Coprime n (sieveProduct N z) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        physicalDivisorSum Q rho n) :
    (RealB b N : ℝ) ≤
      finiteSourceMass S weight * physicalDensitySum Q rho +
        (∑ d ∈ Q, rho d *
          ((finiteCoprimeMass S weight d - finiteSourceMass S weight) /
            (Nat.totient d : ℝ))) +
        (∑ d ∈ Q, rho d * finitePrimitiveDiscrepancy S weight N d) +
        (z : ℝ) + (T + 1) := by
  classical
  have hnonneg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ physicalDivisorSum Q rho n := by
    intro n
    have h := hmajor n
    split_ifs at h with hcop
    · exact zero_le_one.trans h
    · exact h
  have hsum :
      (∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
        physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m)) ≤
      ∑ m ∈ S, weight m * physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m) := by
    calc
      (∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
          physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m)) =
          ∑ m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T,
            (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
              physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro m hm
        simp only [hm, if_pos, one_mul]
      _ = ∑ m ∈ S,
          (if m ∈ realHalfProductSource b N T then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
            physicalDivisorSum Q rho (N - m) := by
        apply Finset.sum_subset hsource
        intro m hmS hmSource
        simp only [if_neg hmSource, zero_mul]
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun m hm =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (houter m hm) (hnonneg (N - m))
  have h := (RealB_cast_le_sum_physicalDivisorSum_add_cap_cutoff
    N z Q rho hb hT hmajor).trans
      (add_le_add (add_le_add hsum (le_refl (z : ℝ))) (le_refl (T + 1)))
  rw [sum_weight_mul_physicalDivisorSum_eq_same_rho_main_add_errors
    N S Q weight rho hSN] at h
  exact h

import ImbalancedChen.RealUpperCountingAssembly
import ImbalancedChen.EnlargedSelbergCap

/-!
# Proved geometric inputs for the actual attached upper coefficient

The majorant and coprime correction in the real counting assembly are
discharged for the literal small/rough coefficient. The sieve cutoff and
the manuscript product cutoff retain their exact natural rounding.
Only the actual density bound and signed distribution estimate remain
analytic premises of the final assembly below.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

noncomputable section
open Filter Topology

/-- A positive exponent gap pays the natural ceiling at the manuscript's
literal lower product cutoff `2 * N^(1-kappa)`. -/
theorem eventually_manuscript_sieve_gate
    {b kappa theta : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (htheta : 0 ≤ theta)
    (hgap : theta < (1 - kappa) * (b / (1 + b))) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      0 < manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N ∧
        (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ theta) : ℝ) ≤
          (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N) ^ (b / (1 + b)) := by
  have halpha : 0 ≤ b / (1 + b) := div_nonneg hb.le (by linarith)
  filter_upwards [eventually_floor_rpow_add_one_le_rpow htheta hgap,
    eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with N hround hN
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < N by omega)
  have hpow : 0 < (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - kappa) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hNpos _
  refine ⟨mul_pos (by norm_num) hpow, ?_⟩
  calc
    (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ theta) : ℝ) ≤
        (Nat.floor ((N : ℝ) ^ theta) : ℝ) + 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.ceil_le_floor_add_one ((N : ℝ) ^ theta)
    _ ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ ((1 - kappa) * (b / (1 + b))) := hround
    _ = ((N : ℝ) ^ (1 - kappa)) ^ (b / (1 + b)) :=
      Real.rpow_mul hNpos.le _ _
    _ ≤ (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N) ^ (b / (1 + b)) := by
      apply Real.rpow_le_rpow hpow.le _ halpha
      change (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - kappa) ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - kappa)
      linarith

/-- The exact finite modulus set of the attached coefficient. -/
def attachedUpperModuli (nu r epsilon : ℝ) (retain : ℕ → List ℕ → Bool)
    (cap : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  actualSmallRoughModuli (retain N) N (cap N)
    ((N : ℝ) ^ (nu * epsilon ^ 2)) ((N : ℝ) ^ (nu * r))

/-- The same coefficient is used for the majorant, density and error. -/
def attachedUpperCoefficient (nu r epsilon : ℝ) (retain : ℕ → List ℕ → Bool)
    (cap : ℕ → ℕ) (N d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  actualSmallRoughRho (retain N) N (cap N)
    ((N : ℝ) ^ (nu * epsilon ^ 2)) ((N : ℝ) ^ (nu * r))
    ((N : ℝ) ^ (nu * epsilon)) d

theorem attachedUpperCoefficient_majorant
    {nu r epsilon : ℝ} (hnu : 0 < nu) (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon)
    (hepsilonOne : epsilon ≤ 1) (hepsilonR : epsilon ^ 2 ≤ r)
    (retain : ℕ → List ℕ → Bool) (cap : ℕ → ℕ)
    {N : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hcap : (N : ℝ) ^ (nu * r) ≤ (cap N : ℝ))
    (n : ℕ) :
    (if Nat.Coprime n (sieveProduct N (Nat.ceil ((N : ℝ) ^ (nu * r))))
      then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
        physicalDivisorSum (attachedUpperModuli nu r epsilon retain cap N)
          (attachedUpperCoefficient nu r epsilon retain cap N) n := by
  have hNreal : (1 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < N by omega)
  have hepsSquare : epsilon ^ 2 ≤ epsilon := by nlinarith
  exact actualSmallRoughRho_sieveProduct_majorant (retain N) N (cap N) _ _ _
    (Real.one_lt_rpow hNreal (mul_pos hnu hepsilon))
    (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hNreal.le
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hepsSquare hnu.le))
    (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hNreal.le
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hepsilonR hnu.le)) hcap n

/-- No estimate is needed for this correction: it is exactly zero beyond
the proved roughness threshold, for every policy and enumeration cap. -/
theorem eventually_attachedUpper_coprimeCorrection_eq_zero
    {b kappa nu r epsilon : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hnu : 0 < nu)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hepsilonR : epsilon ^ 2 ≤ r)
    (hgap : nu * r < (1 - kappa) * (b / (1 + b)))
    (retain : ℕ → List ℕ → Bool) (cap : ℕ → ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      realPhysicalCoprimeCorrection b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N)
        (attachedUpperModuli nu r epsilon retain cap N)
        (attachedUpperCoefficient nu r epsilon retain cap N) = 0 := by
  filter_upwards [eventually_manuscript_sieve_gate hb (mul_nonneg hnu.le hr) hgap,
    eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with N hgate hN
  have hNreal : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN
  apply realPhysicalCoprimeCorrection_eq_zero_of_gate _ _ hb hgate.1 hgate.2
  intro d hd _hactive
  exact actualSmallRoughModuli_dvd_sieveProduct_ceil (retain N) N (cap N) _ _
    (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hNreal
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hepsilonR hnu.le)) hd

/-- The actual construction discharges two of the four same-weight inputs.
This is still conditional on the actual density and signed distribution
estimates; it does not claim that either analytic input has been proved. -/
theorem eventually_RealB_le_currentK_log_of_actual_density_distribution
    {b kappa nu r : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hb1 : b < 1) (hkappa : 0 < kappa)
    (hnu : 0 < nu) (hr : 0 < r) (hsieve : nu * r < 1)
    (hgap : nu * r < (1 - kappa) * (b / (1 + b)))
    (epsilon : ℝ → ℝ) (retain : ℝ → ℕ → List ℕ → Bool)
    (cap : ℝ → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hepsilon : ∀ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta →
      0 < epsilon delta ∧ epsilon delta ≤ 1 ∧ (epsilon delta) ^ 2 ≤ r)
    (hcap : ∀ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta → ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      (N : ℝ) ^ (nu * r) ≤ (cap delta N : ℝ))
    (hdensity : ∀ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta → ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Even N →
      physicalDensitySum (attachedUpperModuli nu r (epsilon delta) (retain delta) (cap delta) N)
        (attachedUpperCoefficient nu r (epsilon delta) (retain delta) (cap delta) N) ≤
          (currentK + delta) * (singularSeries N / Real.log (N : ℝ)))
    (hdistribution : ∀ delta : ℝ, 0 < delta → ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Even N →
      |realPhysicalDistributionError b N (manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N)
        (attachedUpperModuli nu r (epsilon delta) (retain delta) (cap delta) N)
        (attachedUpperCoefficient nu r (epsilon delta) (retain delta) (cap delta) N)| ≤
          delta * singularNormalization N) :
    ∀ tolerance : ℝ, 0 < tolerance → ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, Even N →
      (RealB b N : ℝ) ≤
        (currentK * Real.log (1 / b) + tolerance) * singularNormalization N := by
  apply eventually_RealB_le_currentK_log_of_same_rho_inputs hb hb1 hkappa hsieve
    (fun delta => attachedUpperModuli nu r (epsilon delta) (retain delta) (cap delta))
    (fun delta => attachedUpperCoefficient nu r (epsilon delta) (retain delta) (cap delta))
  · intro delta hdelta
    obtain ⟨heps, hepsOne, hepsR⟩ := hepsilon delta hdelta
    filter_upwards [hcap delta hdelta, eventually_ge_atTop (2 : ℕ)] with N hcover hN
    intro _hEven n
    exact attachedUpperCoefficient_majorant hnu heps hepsOne hepsR
      (retain delta) (cap delta) hN hcover n
  · exact hdensity
  · intro delta hdelta
    filter_upwards [eventually_attachedUpper_coprimeCorrection_eq_zero hb hnu hr.le
      (hepsilon delta hdelta).2.2 hgap (retain delta) (cap delta)] with N hzero
    intro _hEven
    rw [hzero, abs_zero]
    apply mul_nonneg hdelta.le
    have hseries := (singularSeries_pos N).le
    unfold singularNormalization
    positivity
  · exact hdistribution

end
end ImbalancedChen

def realBadPrimes (b : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.range N).filter fun p =>
    Nat.Prime p ∧ RealBadReceiver b (N - p)

/-- Real-exponent bad-representation count. -/
def RealB (b : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : ℕ := (realBadPrimes b N).card

theorem current_theorem_1_1_of_manuscript_bounds

theorem one_le_div (hb : 0 < b) : 1 ≤ a / b ↔ b ≤ a := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hb, one_mul]

theorem div_le_one (hb : 0 < b) : a / b ≤ 1 ↔ a ≤ b := by rw [div_le_iff₀ hb, one_mul]

theorem one_lt_div (hb : 0 < b) : 1 < a / b ↔ b < a := by rw [lt_div_iff₀ hb, one_mul]

theorem div_lt_one (hb : 0 < b) : a / b < 1 ↔ a < b := by rw [div_lt_iff₀ hb, one_mul]

theorem log_pos_iff (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 0 < log x ↔ 1 < x := by
  rcases hx.eq_or_lt with (rfl | hx)
  · simp [zero_le_one]
  rw [← log_one]
  exact log_lt_log_iff zero_lt_one hx

@[bound]
theorem log_pos (hx : 1 < x) : 0 < log x :=
  (log_pos_iff (lt_trans zero_lt_one hx).le).2 hx
